description: Find and validate a domain's DKIM signing key, including key strength. Leave selector empty to auto-scan 26 common selectors (google, selector1, k1, and the rest). When no key is found, reports whether the selectors are delegated by CNAME to a provider that has not published one — the usual Microsoft 365 failure, where the records are right but signing was never switched on.

selector.description: Optional DKIM selector. Omit to auto-scan common selectors.

name: check_dkim
title: DKIM record
